DOCKERFILE=dockerfile-dev

# Optional overrides for dockerfile-dev named build contexts."
# BLOCKDAG_CORECHAIN_CONTEXT=../blockdag-corechain

# set SNAPSHOT_PATH=./latest.bdsnap. The default marker means "build without a
# baked-in snapshot."
SNAPSHOT_PATH=docker/no-snapshot.marker

# Snapshot download link for this node. The installer writes this based on the
# selected install mode. Naming convention on the snapshot host:
#   latest.bdsnap         -> non-archive (pruned) snapshot
#   latest-archive.bdsnap -> archive (full history) snapshot
# The node entrypoint downloads from this URL at first start when no local
# snapshot or chain data exists.
BDAG_SNAPSHOT_URL=
# Set to 1 to run the node in archival mode (--archival; consensus keeps all
# blocks instead of pruning). Archive nodes should bootstrap from the archive
# snapshot so historical data is actually present.
BDAG_NODE_ARCHIVAL=0
# Optional compose services:
#   blank -> base stack only
#   miner -> include CPU miner service (requires DOCKERFILE=dockerfile-dev)
# COMPOSE_PROFILES=miner
